_doc: Hand-kept facts and assumptions. Every number used in the report traces to an entry here or to live data. Addresses are Ethereum mainnet, lowercase.

ethereum.label: Ethereum mainnet (settlement)
ethereum.basis: No fund-losing consensus failure since the Merge; finality was lost twice for ~1h on 2023-05-11/12. Modelled as a 1%/yr liveness event costing ~0.5% (stuck exit, gas spike).

dependencies: Delta-hedged perp shorts on CEXs (funding-rate risk)

depeg.basis: USDe printed ~0.65 on a single CEX order book during the 2025-10-10 liquidation cascade while on-chain pools stayed near peg, and dipped ~0.3% in Apr-2024 on negative funding. Modelled: 12%/yr chance of a depeg averaging ~8%, 75% of it recovered by the horizon.

hack.basis: Loss of a custodian or CEX holding hedges; Ethena's reserve fund covers the first slice. Mean ~29% of backing.

dependencies: Ethereum validator set run by Lido node operators

depeg.basis: stETH/ETH traded ~0.94 in Jun-2022 (3AC/Celsius forced selling); withdrawals since Shapella cap the gap.

hack.basis: Mass slashing or key compromise; mean ~11%.

dependencies: Sky vaults (ETH, RWA, USDC via PSM)

depeg.basis: DAI briefly ~0.90 during the Mar-2023 USDC depeg (PSM exposure).

hack.basis: Governance or oracle attack on the CDP system.

0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb.basis: Fiat-backed; depegged to ~0.88 on 2023-03-11 (SVB). For a borrower, a loan-asset depeg lowers the debt: no loss channel.

0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831e.basis: Fiat/treasury-backed. For a borrower, a loan-asset depeg lowers the debt: no loss channel.

pendle.label: Pendle V2 (AMM, SY/PT/YT contracts)
pendle.basis: A core-contract or SY-adapter exploit reaches PT holders directly. Mean ~14%: Pendle paused and protected ~$105M during the 2024-09 Penpie exploit (Penpie, a protocol built on Pendle, lost ~$27M).

morpho-blue.label: Morpho Blue (isolated market)
morpho-blue.basis: Immutable core, formally verified; exploits of >=$100M lending protocols in the record took <1% of TVL (Aave V3 $0.9M, Venus $3.7M). Mean ~9% of collateral, deliberately above that record.

oracle.basis: Counts misconfigured / stale / predictable oracle exploits only (spot-price manipulation of thin tokens does not apply to a PT oracle), over Lending + CDP protocols >= $1M. Severity: the reading drops ~10% on average, enough to liquidate a high-LTV loop with no real loss of value.

frequency.basis: Exploit frequency = hacks over the last 5 years of protocols in the same current-TVL tier (<$10M, $10M-$100M, >=$100M), all categories pooled, / (protocols in that tier x 5); x the category's rate relative to all categories (clipped 0.5-2); x an age factor. Survivorship: hacked protocols that died are missing from the denominator's tier, which biases small tiers up, not the >=$100M tier.

pt_stress_basis: During an underlying depeg, PT trades below its redemption value as LPs withdraw from the Pendle pool: market-tracking oracles see the depeg amplified by 1.5x.
tail_budget_basis: Recommend reducing when CVaR99, the average loss of the worst 1 % of simulated months, exceeds 50 % of equity.

watch.basis: D26. Shares are of the vault's total assets; the oracle move is between two consecutive state reads; large_flow_info: a deposit or withdrawal by someone else above 1% of total assets.
